title: CPUC Authorizes Expanded Waymo Fared Driverless Service
summary: CPUC approves Waymo's updated Passenger Safety Plan and authorizes fared driverless passenger service in specified Los Angeles and San Francisco Peninsula areas.
key_findings: It depends on DMV deployment authorization and CPUC passenger-service requirements.
The decision does not quantify actual trips or service performance.
why_it_matters: It closes the legal passenger-service gate for a named carrier and geography.
